component.name: Theme Park World
component.summary: Bullfrog's 1999 park builder, recompiled to run natively

description.p: A static recompilation of Theme Park World 2.0: the original game's code translated to C and compiled for this computer, with Windows' parts answered natively. No emulator, no Wine.
The first time it runs, it downloads the game's disc image and its 2.0 patch and builds the game from them, which takes 10 to 20 minutes.
